entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David when Nathan the prophet went to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.>> Have mercy upon me, O God, According to Your lovingkindness; According to the multitude of Your tender mercies, Blot out my transgressions.

entries.title: Psalms 51:2
segments: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:3
segments: For I acknowledge my transgressions, And my sin [is] always before me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments: Against You, You only, have I sinned, And done [this] evil in Your sight-That You may be found just when You speak, [And] blameless when You judge.

entries.title: Psalms 51:5
segments: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, And in sin my mother conceived me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts, And in the hidden [part] You will make me to know wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments: ¶Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: Make me hear joy and gladness, [That] the bones You have broken may rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 51:9
segments: Hide Your face from my sins, And blot out all my iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 51:10
segments: Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And uphold me [by Your] generous Spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: [Then] I will teach transgressors Your ways, And sinners shall be converted to You.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: ¶Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, The God of my salvation, [And] my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: O Lord, open my lips, And my mouth shall show forth Your praise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:16
segments: For You do not desire sacrifice, or else I would give [it]; You do not delight in burnt offering.

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit, A broken and a contrite heart-These, O God, You will not despise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments: Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; Build the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Then You shall be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, With burnt offering and whole burnt offering; Then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.
